taxonomy.invalid: Some values are not valid (marked in red): fix them to be able to save.

pictogram.inherited: Without an image of its own it uses the one of {{code}}.
pictogram.placeholder: Without an image the labels show a disc with the colour and the code.

errors.too_large: The image is too large (at most {{maxMb}} MB).
errors.not_an_image: The file is not an image.
errors.unsupported_format: Format not accepted: use PNG, JPEG or WebP.

position.locked: It has sub-subjects: it stays a main subject.

usage.new: New: no book uses it yet.
usage.some: Used by {{records}} {{records:plural; one:book; other:books;}} ({{copies}} {{copies:plural; one:copy; other:copies;}}).

remove.withSubclasses: Its {{count}} {{count:plural; one:sub-subject is; other:sub-subjects are;}} deleted too.
remove.inUse: {{records}} {{records:plural; one:book uses; other:books use;}} this code: on save, where to move them is asked.

preview.title: Spine band preview
preview.hint: A sample book as it would be printed now, at real size.
preview.needsCode: The preview appears when the code is valid.

problems.codeFormat: Use only letters, digits, dot, dash or underscore (32 at most).
problems.codeTaken: This code is already used by another genre or subject.
problems.labelLong: The name is too long (120 characters at most).
problems.colorFormat: Write the colour as #rrggbb, for example #e8231b.

dewey.hint: When a non-fiction book comes with a Dewey number (for example from SBN), its subject is suggested by this table: the longest matching prefix wins.

options.fictionByClass: Fiction is divided by reading level
options.fictionByClassHint: Fiction books can carry the reading level they suit (for example class 4): it shows in the call number and on the spine band.
options.classPerItem: The reading level is on each copy
options.classPerItemHint: Needed when copies of the same book sit on the shelves of different levels. Otherwise the level is on the book.
options.toCopies: On save the reading level of each book moves to its copies.
options.toRecords: On save the level of the copies goes back to the book; not possible when copies of the same book have different levels.
options.schemeHint: BiblioViva computes the call number of every copy with this scheme. When it changes, on save the call numbers are computed again and the labels that change go back among those to print.
options.placeholdersHint: Placeholders: {{placeholders}}. text is a text per title (in "Edit record"), copytext a text per copy.
options.textProposal: Value proposed for the title's text

save.title: Save the classification
save.checking: Checking what changes in the catalogue…
save.unchanged: There are no changes to save.
save.removedHint: Choose where to move the books of each deleted code: the new code goes on the books, at the start of their call numbers and on the spine bands.
save.moveTo: {{code}} · {{label}}: {{records}} {{records:plural; one:book; other:books;}} ({{copies}} {{copies:plural; one:copy; other:copies;}}). Move to
save.callNumbers: {{count}} {{count:plural; one:copy changes; other:copies change;}} call number: their labels go back among those to print.
save.bandsMoved: The spine bands of the moved books, and the labels whose call number changed, go back among those to print.
save.reprint: Put back among the labels to print the spine bands of {{copies}} {{copies:plural; one:copy; other:copies;}} whose name, colour or pictogram changes ({{codes}})
save.reprintHint: Leave it off if the difference on the bands already stuck on the books does not matter.
save.conflicts: {{count}} {{count:plural; one:book has; other:books have;}} copies in different classes: give the same class to all the copies of each book before taking the class off the copies.
save.toCopies: The associated class of {{count}} {{count:plural; one:book moves; other:books move;}} to their copies.
save.toRecords: The class of the copies goes back to the book for {{count}} {{count:plural; one:title; other:titles;}}.
save.warnings: {{count}} {{count:plural; one:warning; other:warnings;}} (they do not block the save)
save.levelsTitle: Reading levels removed while books carry them
save.levelMoveTo: The books of level {{code}} · {{label}} ({{records}} {{records:plural; one:title; other:titles;}}, {{copies}} {{copies:plural; one:copy; other:copies;}}) move to
save.levelsHint: The level in the copies' call numbers changes with them (for example B 4 DEL becomes B 5 DEL) and their labels go back among those to print.

levels.title: Reading levels
levels.hint: In order, from the easiest. The code goes on the books and into the call number (for example 4 in B 4 DEL), the name shows in the choices. For a level in use that is removed or renamed, saving asks where its books move.
levels.label: Level name

classification.title: Classification

cards.description: Format of the cards and of the print sheet.

labels.title: Labels
labels.description: Book labels and spine bands, adhesive sheets.

photos.title: Patron photos
photos.description: Size and format of the photos.

covers.title: Covers
covers.description: Size, format and sources of the covers.

backup.title: Backup

name.label: Library name
name.hint: Shown at the top left, on the cards and on the printouts.

contactEmail.label: Contact email
contactEmail.hint: Optional: shown on the printouts that include it.

schoolYearStart.label: Start of the school year
schoolYearStart.hint: Month and day as MM-DD (for example 09-01): it separates the years in the statistics.

schoolYearLabel.label: Name of the school year
schoolYearLabel.hint: How the school year appears on cards, reports and pages: two years (2026/2027) or the year it starts (2026), as in Brazil, Japan and Korea.

timezone.label: Time zone
timezone.hint: Name of the zone, for example Europe/Rome: dates and due dates follow it, not the server clock.

weekStart.label: First day of the week
weekStart.hint: The day weeks start from in the calendars and in the dashboard's “this week”. At the first start the language chooses it (Monday in Italian, Sunday in English).

classLabel.label: How a class is written
classLabel.hint: {level} is the year, {group} the class's name: "{level} {group}" gives 3 B, "{level}{group}" gives 3B. A stage can have its own (Stages and years).

groupWord.label: Word for the class
groupWord.hint: The name of the class field in the forms and filters, and {word} in the class line of the card (Section B, Class B, Group B).

cardClass.label: Class on the card
cardClass.hint: The class line printed on the card: {word} is the word for the class, {group} the class's name, {level} the year, {class} the whole class. "{word} {group}" gives Section B, "{class}" gives 3 B.

teacherGroupName.label: Name of the teachers group
teacherGroupName.hint: The group a teacher joins when no other one is picked.

promotionWithinStage.label: At the end of the year, within a stage
promotionWithinStage.hint: Usually the class moves up with its students: 3 B becomes 4 B.

promotionAcrossStages.label: At the end of the year, into another stage
promotionAcrossStages.hint: For example from year 5 of primary to year 1 of lower secondary in a comprehensive school.

specialAuthors.label: Special authors
specialAuthors.hint: One per line: the values accepted instead of a personal author (for example Anonimo, AA. VV.).

unknownPublisher.label: Unknown publisher
unknownPublisher.hint: The value written when the publisher is not given.

unknownPlace.label: Unknown place
unknownPlace.hint: The value written when the place of publication is not given.

enabled.label: School inventory
enabled.hint: Each copy has its inventory number, origin and value; the reports list the copies entered and withdrawn in a period.

origins.label: Origins
origins.hint: One per line: the origins offered in the copy's form (for example Purchase, Gift).

keyboardLayout.label: Computer keyboard
keyboardLayout.hint: The keyboard layout of the computers the barcode scanners are plugged into: it is used to repair the characters a scanner set for another keyboard types wrong.

cameraSound.label: Camera sound
cameraSound.hint: The phone's beep when the camera reads a card, a copy's barcode or an ISBN. The USB scanner beeps by itself and needs none; the desk stays silent.

symbology.label: Barcode type of the cards
symbology.hint: Code 128 for new cards; Code 39 only if the library's scanners cannot read Code 128.

symbology.label: Barcode type of the copies
symbology.hint: Code 128 for new labels; Code 39 only if the library's scanners cannot read Code 128.

loanDays.label: Loan days
loanDays.hint: How many days a loan lasts for students.

maxLoans.label: Most books on loan
maxLoans.hint: How many books one can have at the same time.

maxRenewals.label: Most renewals
maxRenewals.hint: How many times the same loan can be renewed (0 = never).

renewalDays.label: Renewal days
renewalDays.hint: How many days each renewal adds.

loanDays.label: Loan days
loanDays.hint: How many days a loan lasts for teachers.

maxLoans.label: Most books on loan
maxLoans.hint: How many books one can have at the same time.

maxRenewals.label: Most renewals
maxRenewals.hint: How many times the same loan can be renewed (0 = never).

renewalDays.label: Renewal days
renewalDays.hint: How many days each renewal adds.

dueDateMode.label: Due date computation
dueDateMode.hint: How the loan length is counted against the days the library is closed.

renewFrom.label: Renewals start from
renewFrom.hint: The day the renewal days are counted from.

allowRenewalWhenOverdue.label: Renew after the due date too
allowRenewalWhenOverdue.hint: A loan already overdue can be renewed.

template.label: Notice template
template.hint: The name of the print template of the notices (folder in slips/templates).

pageBreakPerGroup.label: One page per class
pageBreakPerGroup.hint: Each class on its own sheet, to hand to the teacher; it can also be changed when printing.

minDays.label: Days late before a notice
minDays.hint: A loan appears in the notices only after these days of delay (0 = at once).

blockIfOverdue.label: No new loans with overdue books
blockIfOverdue.hint: Whoever has an overdue book cannot borrow others until it is returned.

hardDueDate.label: Latest due date
hardDueDate.hint: No loan is due after this date (for example the end of the lessons). Empty: no limit.

receipts.label: Loan receipt
receipts.hint: Shows the button that prints the receipt at the loans desk.

autoItalianHolidays.label: Italian national holidays
autoItalianHolidays.hint: The national holidays (Easter included) are closed days without writing them by hand.

defaultTarget.label: Default server
defaultTarget.hint: The id of the Z39.50 server used for searches.

timeoutMs.label: Waiting time limit (ms)
timeoutMs.hint: After how many milliseconds a Z39.50 search is given up.

maxRecordsIsbn.label: Results per ISBN
maxRecordsIsbn.hint: How many records at most are read when searching an ISBN (one ISBN can have a record per reprint): the most complete one opens.

maxRecordsSearch.label: Results per search
maxRecordsSearch.hint: How many records at most are read when searching by title or author.

providers.label: Data sources
providers.hint: Where the book data comes from when searching by ISBN: the chosen sources are queried together.

cacheDays.label: Days a search is remembered
cacheDays.hint: For how many days a search already made is reused without asking again.

timeoutMs.label: Waiting time limit (ms)
timeoutMs.hint: After how many milliseconds a source that does not answer is dropped.

profile.label: Computer
profile.hint: The default settings that suit the computer BiblioViva runs on.

sqliteCacheMb.label: Database cache (MB)
sqliteCacheMb.hint: Empty: according to the computer (8, 16, 64 or 256 MB).

sqliteMmapMb.label: Database memory map (MB)
sqliteMmapMb.hint: Empty: according to the computer (0, 0, 0 or 512 MB).

walAutocheckpointPages.label: Pages before a checkpoint
walAutocheckpointPages.hint: Empty: according to the computer (500, 1000, 2000 or 4000).

imageConcurrency.label: Images processed together
imageConcurrency.hint: Photos, covers, class pictures and the logo processed at the same time; the others wait their turn. Empty: according to the computer (1, 1, 2 or 4).

yazConcurrency.label: Z39.50 searches together
yazConcurrency.hint: Z39.50 searches at the same time; the others wait their turn. Empty: according to the computer (1, 1, 2 or 2).

heavyConcurrency.label: Prints and exports at a time
heavyConcurrency.hint: Sheets to print (cards, labels, overdue notices, receipts, reports) and exports (CSV, ODS, archives, backups) prepared at the same time; the others wait their turn, so the loan desk stays fast. Empty: according to the computer (1, 1, 2 or 4).

argon2MemoryMb.label: Memory to check passwords (MB)
argon2MemoryMb.hint: Applies to the passwords set from then on. Empty: 16 MB on every computer (the system is never exposed to the Internet).

smol.label: Memory saving
smol.hint: Less memory, a little more work for the processor. Automatic: according to the computer (yes for the minimal computer and the Raspberry Pi). It applies after a restart.

defaultTemplate.label: Card template
defaultTemplate.hint: The name of the print template used when a patron type has none of its own (folder in cards/templates).

layout.label: Card printing
layout.hint: Front and back side by side (folded on the short edge) or on the two sides of the sheet, with a printer that prints both sides. Chosen again at every print.

flip.label: How the sheet turns
flip.hint: How the printer turns the sheet for the back: on its long edge (as a book) or its short edge. It must match the choice in the print window.

x.label: Shift of the backs, across (mm)
x.hint: Found by the calibration: how far the backs move to fall behind the fronts.

width.label: Width (mm)
width.hint: The standard card is 85.6 mm wide.

height.label: Height (mm)
height.hint: The standard card is 53.98 mm high.

bleedMm.label: Bleed (mm)
bleedMm.hint: Extra margin around full-bleed images, cut away.

paper.label: Paper size
paper.hint: The sheet the cards are printed on.

rows.label: Cards per sheet
rows.hint: How many cards (front and back) one under the other: 4 or 5 on an A4 sheet.

marginMm.label: Sheet margin (mm)
marginMm.hint: The white space around the cards.

gapMm.label: Space between cards (mm)
gapMm.hint: The distance between one card and the next.

foldMarks.label: Fold marks
foldMarks.hint: Short dashed lines in the margins and between the cards, where front and back are folded.

cutMarks.label: Cut marks
cutMarks.hint: Crop marks: short lines in the margins and between the cards that extend each card's edges, to cut with a ruler and a cutter.

validityMonths.label: Validity (months)
validityMonths.hint: For how many months a printed card is valid. Empty: it never expires.

showPhoto.label: Photo on the card
showPhoto.hint: Prints the patron's photo on the card.

default.label: Default labels
default.hint: What is printed when choosing “Print labels”.

titleMaxChars.label: Title letters
titleMaxChars.hint: The title on the labels is cut to this length.

monochrome.label: Black-and-white printer
monochrome.hint: On the low spine bands the coloured band becomes a hatched pattern.

template.label: Template
template.hint: The name of the print template of the pair (folder in labels/templates).

stock.label: Adhesive sheet
stock.hint: The id of the label sheet used (file in labels/stocks).

template.label: Template
template.hint: The name of the print template of the barcode label (folder in labels/templates).

stock.label: Adhesive sheet
stock.hint: The id of the label sheet used (file in labels/stocks).

template.label: Template
template.hint: The name of the print template of the spine band (folder in labels/templates).

stock.label: Adhesive sheet
stock.hint: The id of the label sheet used (file in labels/stocks).

enabled.label: Patron photos
enabled.hint: On: photos taken or uploaded for each patron, the census, photos on the cards. Off: no photo anywhere and cards without a photo; the photos already saved stay and come back when it is switched on again.

required.label: Photo required
required.hint: On: the dashboard, the patron list and the print lists point out who has no photo. Off: no reminder, but photos can still be taken, uploaded and printed on the cards.

width.label: Width (px)
width.hint: Photos are stored at this width.

height.label: Height (px)
height.hint: Photos are stored at this height (centre crop).

format.label: File format
format.hint: JPEG works everywhere; WebP takes less space.

quality.label: Quality
quality.hint: From 1 to 100: higher means bigger files.

maxUploadBytes.label: Largest file (bytes)
maxUploadBytes.hint: A picture with many photos (census from a picture) larger than this is refused.

maxPixels.label: Longest side kept (px)
maxPixels.hint: The picture is scaled down until its longest side is not larger than this.

maxFrames.label: Photos at most
maxFrames.hint: When the picture holds more, the sharpest ones are kept.

minAspect.label: Smallest proportion of a photo
minAspect.hint: Height divided by width: 1 is a square, 1.33 a 3:4 ID photo.

maxAspect.label: Largest proportion of a photo
maxAspect.hint: Height divided by width: taller frames are not taken for photos.

enabled.label: Book covers
enabled.hint: On: covers looked up online, photographed or uploaded and shown in the catalogue. Off: no cover anywhere; the covers already saved stay and come back when it is switched on again.

width.label: Width (px)
width.hint: Covers are stored at this width.

maxHeight.label: Largest height (px)
maxHeight.hint: Very tall covers are scaled down. Empty: no limit.

format.label: File format
format.hint: JPEG works everywhere; WebP takes less space.

quality.label: Quality
quality.hint: From 1 to 100: higher means bigger files.

country.label: Country
country.hint: The country of the cover providers' catalogue (two letters, for example IT).

minWidth.label: Smallest width (px)
minWidth.hint: Downloaded covers narrower than this are discarded.

autoFetch.label: Look for the cover by itself
autoFetch.hint: In “New book” the cover is looked up online while the record is checked and is saved with it; if it is wrong, it is replaced with a photo.

timeoutMs.label: Waiting time limit (ms)
timeoutMs.hint: After how many milliseconds a provider that does not answer is dropped.

auditRetentionMonths.label: Months of the audit log
auditRetentionMonths.hint: Older rows of the log are deleted.

cron.label: Backup time
cron.hint: In cron form: minute, hour, day, month, weekday (0 3 * * * = every night at 3).

catchUp.label: Backup at start if missed
catchUp.hint: If the computer was off at the backup time, BiblioViva makes the backup a minute after the next start: only one, even after several days.

enabled.label: Off-site copy in use
enabled.hint: Tells that the second copy of the backups (rclone, on another disk or another service) is in use.

remote.label: Copy destination
remote.hint: Where the copy goes: a folder of another disk (/offsite/biblioviva-backups, the default) or a destination configured in rclone, written as name:folder.

sessionDays.label: Session length (days)
sessionDays.hint: After how many days the password is asked again.

loginMaxAttempts.label: Login attempts
loginMaxAttempts.hint: How many wrong attempts before a forced pause.

loginWindowMinutes.label: Pause after too many attempts (minutes)
loginWindowMinutes.hint: For how many minutes logging in stays blocked after too many attempts.

checkoutIdleSeconds.label: Loans desk idle time (seconds)
checkoutIdleSeconds.hint: After these seconds without scans the desk gets ready for a new patron.

promotionWithinStage.keep: The class moves up with its students
promotionWithinStage.clear: The students are left without a class

promotionAcrossStages.keep: The class moves up with its students
promotionAcrossStages.clear: The students are left without a class
promotionAcrossStages.ask: The class of every student is picked

dueDateMode.datedue: Calendar days, then the first open day

profile.micro: Minimal computer: one slow processor and 512 MB (Raspberry Pi Zero 2, the smallest server)
profile.small: Raspberry Pi 4 with 2 GB or a small computer
profile.medium: Old PC with a hard disk

layout.side-by-side: Front and back side by side
layout.duplex: On both sides of the sheet

sheet.title: Pictures with many photos (census from a picture)

overview.reloadFailed: The files have errors: the previous configuration stays in use.
overview.valid: The configuration is valid: {{count}} {{count:plural; one:file; other:files;}}.
overview.example: The configuration has not been created yet: the example values are used.
overview.diskErrors: The configuration files have errors: the library keeps the previous version until they are fixed.
overview.diskChanged: The files were changed by hand: press “Reload” to use the changes.
overview.templatesDescription: Template folders of cards, labels and notices, with their images.
overview.reportsDescription: Shipped and school reports: try, download, upload, delete.
overview.appearanceDescription: The library's name and logo, colours, language and the dashboard's sections.
overview.classesDescription: The school's classes and the teachers' groups: create, rename, archive.

section.willReset: On save it goes back to the default.
section.invalid: Fix the marked values before saving.
section.inUse: The save would take away something still in use:
section.elsewhereHint: These are changed with a dedicated editor or in the JSON tab.
section.jsonOnly: In the JSON tab for now

json.hint: The section as written in {{file}}. Keys starting with _ are comments and stay in the file.
json.label: JSON content of the section
json.parseError: The text is not valid JSON: {{message}}
json.notObject: The section must be a JSON object in curly braces.

history.title: Configuration history
history.hint: Every change made from here keeps the previous version of the files it touches (the last 50 changes).
history.empty: No change made from the administration yet.
history.revertTitle: Restore the files as they were before this change?
history.revertDescription: Only the values set by this change go back. The restore is a change too: it stays in the history and can be undone.
history.refused: This change created config.json: it cannot be undone.
history.conflict: It cannot be restored: after this change {{keys}} changed again.
history.notFound: The change is no longer in the history.

archive.title: Configuration archive
archive.hint: The whole configuration in one file: settings, print templates, adhesive sheets, pictograms, logo, reports and languages (not the history). Use it to keep a copy or to move it to another installation. “Import configuration” also takes a backup or an “Export everything” archive: it takes only the configuration from it, the library's data stays as it is.
archive.files: {{added}} {{added:plural; one:new file; other:new files;}}, {{changed}} changed, {{removed}} removed, {{unchanged}} unchanged.
archive.errorsTitle: The archive has problems: they must be fixed before importing it.
archive.confirmTitle: Replace the configuration with the archive's?
archive.confirmDescription: The current files stay in the history: “Restore” brings back the previous configuration. The library's data (books, patrons, loans) does not change.

errors.too_large: The archive is too large (at most {{maxMb}} MB).
errors.not_zip: The file is not a valid ZIP archive.
errors.not_archive: The file is not a BiblioViva archive.
errors.too_many_files: The archive holds too many files.
errors.unsafe_path: The archive holds a path that is not allowed: {{name}}
errors.link: The archive holds a link, which is not allowed: {{name}}
errors.unknown_file: The archive holds a file that is not part of the configuration: {{name}}
errors.no_config: The archive holds no configuration (only library data): it is restored from Administration → Backups.

codeFormat.itemTypes: Letters, digits, dot, dash or underscore (32 at most).
codeFormat.sections: Capital letters or digits, 8 at most.

itemTypes.title: Materials
itemTypes.hint: Book, DVD, magazine…: the material of each book applies to all its copies and decides their loan rules. Changing a code moves its books to the new code.
itemTypes.label: Name

hint.copies: Some removed types still have books: choose the type to move them to.
hint.students: Some removed sections still have students: choose the section to move them to.

barcodes.title: Numbering and preview
barcodes.afterLegacy: After the highest number of the cards that already exist
barcodes.fromNumber: First number of the new cards
barcodes.counterHint: A number already used never comes back: if the chosen number is lower, the count goes on from where it got to. New copies always have the year and a running number.
barcodes.overrides: These print templates choose the barcode type themselves, so the setting above does not apply to them: {{templates}}.

itemTypeRules.title: Rules per material
itemTypeRules.hint: Each material can change a rule: for example DVDs for 5 days. The rules apply to students and teachers alike.
itemTypeRules.inherit: Empty: the rule of students and teachers applies (in grey: students / teachers).

calendar.title: Library calendar
calendar.weeklyHint: The highlighted days are closed every week.
calendar.autoOn: The national holidays are already closed automatically. A click on an open day closes it; on a day closed by hand it opens it again.
calendar.clickHint: A click on an open day closes it; on a day closed by hand it opens it again.
calendar.badRange: The end is before the start.

cardTemplates.title: Template per patron type
cardTemplates.hint: Students and teachers print their card with the default template chosen above, unless another one is chosen here.
cardTemplates.cutLinesOn: Draw a coloured outline on each card (usually not needed: the crop marks are enough)

stocks.title: Adhesive label sheets
stocks.hint: The measures of the label sheets printed on. The drawing on the right follows every number: labels that go past the sheet are red. After saving, print the test page on plain paper and lay it over the label sheet.
stocks.name: Name
stocks.inUse: Used for: {{jobs}}. To delete it, first choose another sheet in the settings above.
stocks.saveFirst: Save the changes to print the test page.
stocks.drawing: Drawing of the A4 sheet with {{columns}} {{columns:plural; one:column; other:columns;}} and {{rows}} {{rows:plural; one:row; other:rows;}} of labels
stocks.caption: A4 sheet · {{count}} {{count:plural; one:label; other:labels;}}

problems.id: The code may have letters, digits, hyphens and underscores.
problems.duplicate: Another sheet already has this code.
problems.name: Write a name.
problems.numbers: Check the measures: numbers from 0 up, labels bigger than zero, whole columns and rows.

barcodeFormats.title: Code formats
barcodeFormats.hint: How the codes of new copies and new cards are made. Codes already printed keep working: a replaced format stays among the previous formats.
barcodeFormats.checkHint: It spots a code read or typed wrong. The letter is the safest and makes cards look different from copy codes at a glance.
barcodeFormats.advanced: Advanced: the formats one by one
barcodeFormats.tokens: YYYY or YY = year, N = digits of the running number, C = check character, {lib} = library code, - = dash, capital letters in quotes ('T'). The letters I, O and Q are not allowed.
barcodeFormats.libraryCodeHint: Only when several libraries with separate installations must have different codes: used with {lib} in the format.
barcodeFormats.plainMaxLength: Digits of the old plain numbers
barcodeFormats.plainHint: The largest number of digits of the cards and copies of the previous system that have no format (0 if there are none).
barcodeFormats.plainLongest: The longest plain number stored has {{digits}} {{digits:plural; one:digit; other:digits;}}.
barcodeFormats.distinct: Copies and cards cannot be confused.
barcodeFormats.confusable: With these formats copies and cards could be confused:
barcodeFormats.inUse: The format {{pattern}} still has {{count}} {{count:plural; one:code; other:codes;}} stored: it cannot be removed.
barcodeFormats.tryHint: A code typed or scanned here is recognised with the formats above, even before they are saved.

tried.ambiguous: {{value}}: an old plain number (looked up among copies and cards)
tried.invalid: {{value}}: not recognised or wrong check character

patternErrors.badLetter: {{pattern}}: letter not allowed (capitals only, not I, O, Q)
patternErrors.year: {{pattern}}: the year is written YYYY or YY
patternErrors.twoCounters: {{pattern}}: the running number must be one group of N
patternErrors.checkWithoutAlgorithm: {{pattern}}: there is a C but no check is chosen
patternErrors.algorithmWithoutCheck: {{pattern}}: C, the place of the check character, is missing
patternErrors.noLibraryCode: {{pattern}}: uses {lib} but the library code is empty
patternErrors.badLibraryCode: The library code may contain digits and capital letters only (not I, O, Q)

issues.overlap: {{pattern}} ({{kind}}) and {{other}} ({{otherKind}}) can give the same code, e.g. {{example}}

issues.overlapLegacy: The old codes {{pattern}} ({{kind}}) and {{other}} ({{otherKind}}) have the same shape: they are looked up in both
issues.overlapPlain: {{pattern}} ({{kind}}) can give a code equal to an old plain number, e.g. {{example}}
issues.overlapIsbn: {{pattern}} ({{kind}}) can give a code equal to an ISBN, e.g. {{example}}

issues.lookAlike: {{pattern}} ({{kind}}) and {{other}} ({{otherKind}}) look too much alike: they need a length difference of at least 2 characters, a letter in another place or a dash elsewhere

languages.title: Language packs
languages.hint: To use BiblioViva in another language: download the English or Italian example, translate the texts of the JSON files keeping the keys and the placeholders in double curly braces unchanged, write the language's name in pack.json and upload the zip. A pack with errors is not installed; missing texts show in English. The language is chosen in Appearance and language.

reports.title: Reports library
reports.hint: The reports shipped with BiblioViva and the school's own. To customise one, download it, change it and upload it: with the same code (id) it takes the place of the original. Before it is installed, the format, the safety of the query and the tables and columns it uses are checked. The guide to writing reports is docs/reports-authoring.md.
reports.removeHint: The file is deleted from the configuration. It can be undone from the history.
reports.restoreHint: The school's version is deleted: the report shipped with BiblioViva is used again. It can be undone from the history.
